description:
## Problem
Trunk run 44457489422 (develop 3d7619eef, after #4379, 2026-11-19) failed job `tpcds-parity-draws`. `make tpcds-cross-surface-draws-report` printed "0 divergent" and "SQL and DataFrame surfaces are equivalent" for all three draws, then `make` exited 1 from make/reports.mk:37. The log names no failing draw. A re-run of the same commit passed, so develop went red for about an hour and blocked every pr-arm with no actionable cause.

## Decision gate
Reproduce or explain the exit status: per draw, capture the exit code of `python -m benchbox.core.equivalence.cross_surface` and anything written to stderr. If a draw exits non-zero after printing "equivalent", fix the reporting so the reason is printed. If the cause is a crash/timeout in a backend (pandas/datafusion), fix or record it with the evidence. Do not mark as flaky without a cause.

## Guardrails
- Do not swallow the non-zero status or add retries to the target.
- Do not narrow the draws or backends.

## Verification rubric
Either a reproduced cause with a fix and a test that a non-zero draw prints its reason, or a recorded root cause with log evidence.
